query: Let `f : α → β` and `g : β → γ` be Scott-continuous on a domain family `D` of subsets of `α` (resp. `D'` of `β`). Suppose `D` is closed under two-element subsets `{a,b}` (with `a ≤ b`) and that `f` sends `D`-sets to `D'`-sets after image. Then `g ∘ f` is Scott continuous on `D`.

    10  public import Mathlib.Topology.Order.UpperLowerSetTopology
    11  
    12  /-!
    13  # Scott topology
    14  
    15  This file introduces the Scott topology on a preorder.
    16  
    17  ## Main definitions
    18  
    19  - `Topology.scottHausdorff`: the Scott-Hausdorff topology is the topology whose closed sets are
    20    `DirSupClosed`, i.e. closed under directed suprema.
    21  - `Topology.scott` - the Scott topology is defined as the join of the topology of upper sets and the
    22    Scott-Hausdorff topology (the topological space where a set `u` is open if, when the least upper
    23    bound of a directed set `d` lies in `u` then there is a tail of `d` which is a subset of `u`).
    24  
    25  ## Main statements
    26  
    27  - `Topology.IsScott.isUpperSet_of_isOpen`: Scott open sets are upper.
    28  - `Topology.IsScott.isLowerSet_of_isClosed`: Scott closed sets are lower.
    29  - `Topology.IsScott.monotone_of_continuous`: Functions continuous w.r.t. the Scott topology are
    30    monotone.
    31  - `Topology.IsScott.scottContinuousOn_iff_continuous` - a function is Scott continuous (preserves
    32    least upper bounds of directed sets) if and only if it is continuous w.r.t. the Scott topology.
    33  - `Topology.IsScott.instT0Space` - the Scott topology on a partial order is T₀.
    34  
    35  ## Implementation notes
    36  
    37  A type synonym `WithScott` is introduced and for a preorder `α`, `WithScott α` is made an instance
    38  of `TopologicalSpace` by the `scott` topology.
    39  
    40  We define a mixin class `IsScott` for the class of types which are both a preorder and a
    41  topology and where the topology is the `scott` topology. It is shown that `WithScott α` is an
    42  instance of `IsScott`.
    43  
    44  A class `Scott` is defined in `Topology/OmegaCompletePartialOrder` and made an instance of a
    45  topological space by defining the open sets to be those which have characteristic functions which
    46  are monotone and preserve limits of countable chains (`OmegaCompletePartialOrder.Continuous'`).
    47  A Scott continuous function between `OmegaCompletePartialOrder`s is always
    48  `OmegaCompletePartialOrder.Continuous'` (`OmegaCompletePartialOrder.ScottContinuous.continuous'`).
    49  The converse is true in some special cases, but not in general
    50  ([Domain Theory, 2.2.4][abramsky_gabbay_maibaum_1994]).
    51  
    52  ## References
    53  
    54  * [Abramsky and Jung, *Domain Theory*][abramsky_gabbay_maibaum_1994]
    55  * [Gierz et al, *A Compendium of Continuous Lattices*][GierzEtAl1980]
    56  * [Karner, *Continuous monoids and semirings*][Karner2004]
    57  
    58  ## Tags
    59  
    60  Scott topology, preorder
    61  -/

    64  
    65  open Set

    69  namespace Topology

    71  /-! ### Scott-Hausdorff topology -/
    72  
    73  /-- The Scott-Hausdorff topology.
    74  
    75  A set `u` is open in the Scott-Hausdorff topology iff when the least upper bound of a directed set
    76  `d` lies in `u` then there is a tail of `d` which is a subset of `u`.
    77  
    78  For mild conditions on `D`, this is equivalent to saying that open sets are `DirSupInaccOn D`,
    79  and closed sets are `DirSupClosedOn D`. -/
